answer: Treat sponsorship as a finite credit line. Before agents ivory, orchard and cipher receive job quotas, their sponsor locks collateral and divides a fixed liability budget among them. The ledger reserves each allocation until settlement; signed evidence of double-claiming forfeits its backing. Aliases share the same budget, so spawning keys adds no aggregate quota. An attacker must immobilize more collateral to obtain more capacity and risks losing it when fraud is proved.
